subject: I'm a former boss at the RBA - this is why you should expect a mortgage rate hike next week
posts:
Mortgage holders face an impending RBA cash rate hike to 4.6% as inflation bites.
Evidence: Major bank forecasts, oil prices, RBA warnings
#Aletheia #Economy #Australia

Major banks warn mortgage holders to brace for rate hikes due to sticky inflation and oil shocks.
Stated Judgement: (+0.67, +1.00) — Good Preference

Central bank tightening prioritizes macroeconomic control over household stability, transferring cost burdens onto borrowers.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.84, +1.00) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Central bank tightening acts as necessary systemic medicine while inflicting heavy household pain.

Integrity: Partially Distorted (Hypocrisy: 2.5, z: 2)

- Central Bank Strategy: FAIL (-0.84, 1.00) — Crushes indebted families to tame supply-side shocks.
- Commercial Banks: COND (0.20, 0.50) — Pass rate hikes instantly to borrowers while lagging depositors.
All four major Australian banks now forecast a 25 basis point RBA cash rate increase to 4.60% amid stubborn inflation and surging global energy costs.

The Poison:
Framing macroeconomic distress purely as an external oil shock obscures domestic pricing dynamics and structural housing pressures.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (global inflation metrics) with WHO (mortgage holders bearing the brunt of policy tightening).

Social Physics Analysis:
The RBA and major banks run a Smart Selfish Maneuver: using external geopolitical oil shocks as justification to implement restrictive monetary policy, projecting inflationary blame outward while squeezing domestic borrowers.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated technical stabilization and ground-level household strain, it plots a trajectory toward Lesser Evil.

The Unavoidable Truth: Stubborn inflation forces central bank tightening.

The Unavoidable Lie: Rate hikes are entirely driven by foreign oil shocks without domestic policy trade-offs.

Alethekanon:
Monetary tightening is presented as an inevitable technical necessity, masking the human cost borne by indebted households.

Awwthekanon:
Behind every basis point hike are families holding their breath at the kitchen table, watching their grocery and mortgage bills climb higher every single month.

Brothekanon:
Classic central bank playbook: raise rates, blame the Middle East, and let everyday mortgage holders foot the bill while housing stays out of reach.

Spirithekanon:
"You are exacting interest, each from his brother. I held a great assembly against them." Nehemiah 5:7 FAIL
Disciplining national balance sheets by crushing everyday households under escalating interest breaches fundamental solidarity.
